title: Services
description: What runs where: every container on the habitat's machines, as their container exporters read them, and every service the habitat placed on a host (a systemd unit or a launchd service), as its own readings serve them.

list.name: scope
list.label: show
list.description: The habitat's containers carry hale.habitat; everything else a host runs carries none. A service the habitat placed is always the habitat's.

list.name: organism
list.label: organism

query.query: query_result(group by (organism) (label_replace(container_last_seen{job="containers", container_label_hale_organism!=""}, "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.+)")) or group by (organism) (up{job="services", organism!=""}))

list.definition: query_result(group by (organism) (label_replace(container_last_seen{job="containers", container_label_hale_organism!=""}, "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.+)")) or group by (organism) (up{job="services", organism!=""}))

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Containers each machine runs now, as its container exporter last saw them, and the services placed there that answer.

targets.expr: count by (host) ((max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(container_last_seen{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"} * 0 + 1, "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(up{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}, "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))) == 1)

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: What runs where: each container (kind container, with its organism and part) and each placed service (kind systemd or launchd), whether it is up, how long it has been, its memory and its CPU. A placed service whose readings do not answer is down, and stays in the table.

targets.expr: max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(container_last_seen{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"} * 0 + 1, "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(up{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}, "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))

max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(time() - container_start_time_seconds{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}, "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(time() - hale_process_start_time_seconds{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}, "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))

max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}, "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or max by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(hale_process_resident_memory_bytes{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}, "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))

sum by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}[$__rate_interval]), "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or sum by (kind, host, organism, part, name, image) (label_replace(rate(hale_process_cpu_seconds_total{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}[$__rate_interval]), "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores each container or placed service keeps busy (1 = one core).

targets.expr: sum by (kind, host, organism, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}[$__rate_interval]), "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or sum by (kind, host, organism, name) (label_replace(rate(hale_process_cpu_seconds_total{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}[$__rate_interval]), "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Each container's working set (what the kernel would not reclaim from it), and each placed service's resident memory.

targets.expr: max by (kind, host, organism, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}, "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or max by (kind, host, organism, name) (label_replace(hale_process_resident_memory_bytes{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}, "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Containers' traffic, in above the line, out below. A container on its host's network shows none of its own, nor does a placed service.

targets.expr: sum by (host, organism, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}[$__rate_interval]), "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)"))

-sum by (host, organism, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}[$__rate_interval]), "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Restarts and OOM kills in the window
panels.description: Containers and placed services that started again, and containers the kernel killed for memory, within the dashboard's time range.

targets.expr: (sum by (kind, host, organism, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(changes(container_start_time_seconds{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}[$__range]), "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) or sum by (kind, host, organism, name) (label_replace(changes(hale_process_start_time_seconds{job="services", host=~"$host", organism=~"$organism"}[$__range]), "name", "$1", "service", "(.*)"))) > 0

sum by (kind, host, organism, name) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(increase(container_oom_events_total{job="containers", host=~"$host", name!="", container_label_hale_habitat=~"$scope", container_label_hale_organism=~"$organism"}[$__range]), "kind", "container", "", ""), "organism", "$1", "container_label_hale_organism", "(.*)"), "part", "$1", "container_label_hale_role", "(.*)")) > 0
